name: refactoring-guru
description: Refactoring.Guru's smell and technique catalog as a Claude Code toolkit: diagnose a named smell, apply the smallest safe treatment, verify, and stop before redesign. Skills, subagents and output styles built on a paraphrased rule set for coding agents.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Refactoring.Guru rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
